title: S2: 視覺風格方向 (Style Tiles)
acceptance: Produce 2-3 style tile variants showing: color mood, typography personality, radius/shadow tendency, density, light/dark mode
Variant A: Current institutional slate/emerald (#1b4332 primary, amber accent) — the default
Variant B: Lighter, airier version (more white space, softer greens)
Variant C: Higher contrast, more authoritative (darker slates, bolder typography)
Each variant references 1-2 production products (PEAK, CII HK, or from design-craft reference list)
Present with comparison table: clarity, authority, accessibility, implementation effort
Human picks one — record in design-system.md '風格方向'
notes: Apply design-craft discipline: type scale, 4px spacing, color as system, depth rules. Current style is already close to institutional slate/emerald from proposal — variants should explore adjacent directions, not radical departures.
verification: Human selects a style direction. Selected variant written to design-system.md.
